name: Gwawl

attributes.attribute: A minor character in the Welsh Mabinogion.
He sought the hand of Rhiannon against Pwyll.
Through trickery he made Pwyll yield in his courtship.
Pwyll tricked him into crawling into a bag used like a football.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwawl ap Clud is a rival suitor to Rhiannon in the Mabinogi's first branch. He is the child of the goddess Clud, and his name may mean light, wall, or hedge. Though Gwawl seems slow-witted, he comes close to winning Rhiannon. Pwyll, her true suitor, takes revenge through the game of badger-in-the-bag. In that cruel game Gwawl is trapped and killed. Later the enchanter Llwyd strikes back on Gwawl's behalf. Gwawl may have come from Clydeside in the far north.

okr.objective: Summarize the role of Gwawl as a rival suitor to Rhiannon in the Mabinogion.
key_results: Gwawl is a minor Mabinogion character
He competed with Pwyll for Rhiannon's hand
